text:
eva_support: FYI incoming ticket — ACME Corp payment for INV-2025-042 failed and is blocking their onboarding. They submitted PO ACME-PO-7788 but finance says PO lines don't match invoice. Also card decline from processor. Need quick triage and a one-off payment terms adjustment (customer asking to move to net-60 while PO is sorted). :eyes:

jamal_finance: Can you paste the processor error and the PO/invoice mismatch details? If it's just line-item tax vs subtotal we can do a provisional release.

eva_support: Pasted error from payment webhook below. Customer claims VAT should be reverse-charged (EU buyer). PO shows VAT-exempt flag but invoice includes VAT.

---
```
{"error":"card_declined","decline_code":"insufficient_funds","processor":"Stripe","payment_method_last4":"4242","attempts":1}
```
---

noah_ops: Quick note — our billing webhook retried twice then gave up. Logs show 402 from Stripe. I've attached the webhook payload (omitted here).

tess_accounting: From the PO ACME-PO-7788: vendor sent 2 line items, qty/prices match but PO references "reverse_vat=true" in notes. Our invoice generator didn't honor that flag because the customer profile had no EU VAT id. Need confirmation from sales/legal.

jamal_finance: Options: 1) Hold invoicing until PO is reconciled (customer unhappy). 2) Issue provisional credit or temporary access while we sort VAT (manual approval required). 3) Force net terms change for this account to net-60 for 1 invoice only. Which do we want to pursue?

eva_support: Customer is blocked from going live — they asked to be allowed to use dedicated capacity. They offered to sign a temporary SLA addendum. They want access today. They're insisting it's our system bug for ignoring PO flag. :pleading_face:

noah_ops: For immediate unblock we can create a manual invoice override and mark it "pending_PO_review" so billing APIs accept payment method and release the environment. We'll still need finance sign-off to take the payment without a matching PO.

jamal_finance: I'll approve a provisional release if sales confirms PO intent. @tess_accounting please prepare a manual invoice note referencing ACME-PO-7788 and set terms = "Net 60 (temporary)". Also we need an email trail from the buyer accepting the temporary terms.

tess_accounting: On it. I've created a draft billing memo and tagging Sales for confirmation. AM Sarah @sales will ping the customer. Checklist: [x] draft invoice note, [ ] customer email confirming net-60, [ ] manual payment release, [ ] mark invoice for VAT follow-up.

billing-bot: Payment attempt logged: INV-2025-042, attempt_id=pay_8ZxkL, status=failed, decline_code=insufficient_funds. Next retry scheduled in 36 hours unless manual action taken.

eva_support: Repro steps we used to validate: 1) Customer uploaded PO via portal (ACME-PO-7788). 2) Created account + billing profile (no VAT id). 3) System generated invoice with VAT included. 4) Customer initiated card payment -> webhook failure. Steps to reproduce in staging: POST /billing/portal/po {"po": "ACME-PO-7788", "reverse_vat": true} then POST /billing/invoices/pay invoice=INV-2025-042 -> see decline.

jamal_finance: Decision: approve provisional release for today with terms set to Net 60 (one-off). Finance will process manual capture pending PO reconciliation and VAT validation. Sales to get confirmation email. Finance to re-audit invoice after PO/VAT resolved and adjust ledger entries if needed.

noah_ops: I'll flip the manual flag and set env access to "provisioned-temp". Leave TTL 7 days.

tess_accounting: Done — invoice annotated, awaiting customer confirmation email. I've added tags: accounting:manual_review, customer:acme, po:ACME-PO-7788.

eva_support: Thanks team. I'll let the customer know we're provisioning access under temporary Net-60 while we sort the VAT/PO mismatch. Please keep me posted if finance needs any docs. :pray:

jamal_finance: Also note for the postmortem: ensure portal PO upload honors reverse_vat flag even when VAT id missing, and add a validation warning for customers. Filed follow-up ticket in billing backlog.

noah_ops: filed as BILL-2147. Adding acceptance criteria: validation warning and a one-click provisional release workflow for support.

eva_support: Closing loop once customer confirms email. Adding :thumbsup: when done.
